title: Going with Dr. Moon to get a saxophone job
summary: Joe, wanting to join a circus and needing a saxophone first, ends up with Doc Moon, whose tonic was said to cure everything.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What was the purpose of you going with them?
Well, I was in Opelousas, and I always wanted to go... My idea was to go with a circus.
That's right, you did say that earlier.
I wanted to get ahold of a saxophone first. They'd hire you quicker if you played saxophone and clarinet.

Alto. E-Flat alto saxophone. So Doc Moon hired... A strange thing, Doc Moon's headquarters was in Baton Rouge, and I knew him. He never played... He did play in Baton Rouge sometimes, but I can't remember going to his medicine show in Baton Rouge. But he kept his supply houses, his bottles, and he made some of this Moon's Tonic in Baton Rouge.
What was it supposed to fix?
Everything. It would cure anything! Name something it didn't fix. [LAUGHS]
You mean that it was supposed to fix, whether it fixed it or not.
Well, I'll tell you one thing, Barry. People would swear by it.
